**Early Stopping Training:** Train the model by monitoring reconstruction loss $L_{rec}$.
If $L_{rec}$ has not decreased by 0.01% over 500 iterations, reduce the learning rate by a factor of 10.
*   **Time Complexity:** Training time is reduced significantly by parallelizing across GPUs and using early stopping.
